# TODO Group POC flux by profile groups
```{r}

# If lipid flux is based on direct average of all profiles
profile_totals_5m <- profile_sums_m2 %>% 
  filter(sample_id %notin% to_exclude$sample_id)


pocFlux.pgs <- pocFlux %>% 
  left_join(profile_sums_m2 %>% 
              distinct(sample_id, profile_group, region.inuktitut, sample_cruise),
            by = "sample_id") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(profile_group)) %>% 
  
  # average by profile group
  group_by(sample_cruise, Depth_5m, profile_group, region.inuktitut) %>% 
  summarise(mean_volume_L = mean(Sampled_volume_L, na.rm = T),
            total_volume_L = sum(Sampled_volume_L, na.rm = T),
            mean_model_flux = mean(ModelFlux, na.rm = T),
            mean_flux_err = mean(fluxErr, na.rm = T),
            nprofiles = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Average by 100 m bins
pocFlux.pgs_100m <- pocFlux.pgs %>% 
  # filter(mean_model_flux < 500) %>%  # TODO verify
  mutate(depth100 = floor(Depth_5m/100)*100+100) %>% 
  group_by(sample_cruise, depth100, profile_group, region.inuktitut) %>% 
  summarise(mean_model_flux = mean(mean_model_flux),
            mean_flux_err = mean(mean_flux_err),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(cr_pgs = paste0(sample_cruise,profile_group))

# plot flux per region...
ggplot(pocFlux.pgs_100m, aes(x = as.factor(depth100),
                        y = mean_model_flux)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(~region.inuktitut, scales = "free") +
  coord_flip() + scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  ylab("POC Flux (mg C m-2 d-1)")

ggplot(pocFlux.pgs_100m, aes(x = as.factor(depth100),
                        y = mean_model_flux,
                        group = cr_pgs)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~region.inuktitut, scales = "free", nrow = 2) +
  coord_flip() + scale_x_discrete(limits = rev) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  ylab("POC Flux (mg C m-2 d-1)")


```

# Calculate regional flux
```{r}

# POC flux, get average flux at depth range of 200-300 m
# values in mg C m-2 d-1
df_poc_flux <- pocFlux.pgs %>% 
  filter(Depth_5m >= 200 & Depth_5m <= 300) %>% 
  group_by(sample_cruise, region.inuktitut, profile_group) %>% 
  summarise(poc_model = mean(mean_model_flux, na.rm = T),
            poc_error = mean(mean_flux_err, na.rm = T),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  # Convert to annual flux... 
  # TODO temporary and should not simply be *365 because of interannual variability
  # mutate(poc_model = poc_model * 365 / 1000,
  #        poc_error = poc_error * 365 / 1000) %>% 
  # The observations are the average for only Jul-October (4 months), the rest of the year, the primary production is lower and POC flux is likely much lower
  mutate(poc_model = (poc_model * 123 / 1000) + (poc_model/4 * 242 / 1000),
         poc_error = (poc_error * 123 / 1000) + (poc_error/4 * 242 / 1000))


ggplot(df_poc_flux, aes(x = region.inuktitut,
                        y = poc_model)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  coord_flip() +
  ylab("POC Flux (g C m-2 y-1)")
```


# Combined data frames
```{r}
df_poc_flux_region <- df_poc_flux %>% 
  group_by(region.inuktitut) %>% 
  summarise(poc_model = mean(poc_model),
            poc_error = mean(poc_error), 
            .groups = "drop")
  
# Only the samples at depth >200 m are included
flux_comparison <- regions_m2 %>% 
  mutate(region_mean = Total_C_Flux_mean, 
         region_sd = Total_C_Flux_sd) %>% 
  # regional_averages %>%
  # filter(variable == "Total_C_Flux") %>% 
  left_join(df_poc_flux_region, by = join_by(region.inuktitut))

ggplot(flux_comparison, 
       aes(x = poc_model, y = region_mean, color = region.inuktitut)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = poc_model-poc_error,
                    xmax = poc_model+poc_error)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = region_mean-region_sd,
                    ymax = region_mean+region_sd)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,40,2)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0,40,2)) +
  # scale_x_log10() + 
  # scale_y_log10() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = unique(region_rename$region.color)) +
  xlab("POC flux (UVP6 200-300m)\n(g C m-2 y-1)") + 
  ylab("Lipid Pump (g C m-2 y-1)")

ggsave("figures/lipid_gravity_comparison_allprofiles_100m.png",
       width = 5, height = 5, units = "in", bg = "white")
```

# With historical POC flux from literature
```{r}
sedTrap <- read.csv("data/Sediment_trap_literature_20251117.csv") %>% 
  # Remove the anomalously high value for Mackenzie shelf
  filter(Daily_Flux != 7000) %>% 
  filter(VarCode %notin% c("FPOC","60-80umPOC","80-100umPOC",
                                  "100-120POC","120POC",
                                  "MaxTPOC","MeanTPOC"))

# Annual averages
sedTrap_annual <- sedTrap %>% 
  mutate(Annual_Flux = as.numeric(Annual_Flux)) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(Annual_Flux)) %>% 
  group_by(RefID, AreaCode) %>% 
  summarise(flux_mean = mean(Annual_Flux, na.rm = T),
            flux_sd = sd(Annual_Flux, na.rm = T),
            min = min(Annual_Flux),
            max = max(Annual_Flux),
            n = n(), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(sedTrap, 
       aes(x = Depth_m, y = Daily_Flux)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = VarCode, shape = Area),
             size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  ylab("POC flux (mg C m-2 d-1)") +
  xlab("Depth (m)") 



```
